## Summary

**`secret_leak` is a registered suite veto over recorded findings —
never a rescan.** `veto_id::SECRET_LEAK` joins the closed veto-id set
(`veto: true`, `charged_to: instrument`, `mediated(egress)`-gated);
`LedgerFacts` folds `security.secret.leak_detected` rows as coordinates
only (location/detector/fingerprint — never the value), and
`VetoContext.secret_scan_findings` carries the suite-declared `leak_scan`
verdict over model request views (LT-11's surface — the battery scans,
the veto reads declarations; CC5). A leak row *or* a non-empty scan
finding makes the run success-with-veto, never headline
(ADR-0289 D1; `hh-eval/tests/s3_11b.rs`).

**The LT-12 encoded detector enumerates encodings of *known* values —
it never guesses encodings on untrusted text.** `hh-secrets::encoded`
computes `encoded_forms(value)` = {base64 std/url, hex lo/hi, percent}
for mask-set values ≥ `ENCODED_MIN_LEN` (8) and scans for those
spellings; `miss_rate` folds a seeded corpus into
`secret_detector_miss_rate` (ppm; `n/a{estimator_undefined}` on empty),
with over-fires reported under `extra`, never netted (ADR-0289 D3).

**`audit_completeness` now reads the projected `audit_view` verdict.**
`AuditVerdict{headline, coverage_unmet[], failing[]}` is the caller's
projection of `audit_view.completeness` + `coverage.unmet`; the veto
trips on `headline = false` or any unmet obligation and names the
failing components — `n/a{reason}` components are clean non-components,
never failures (AC-R-2.8.6-13; ADR-0289 D2). `VetoContext.audit = None`
keeps the Stage-2 open-effects arm (additive, CC8). **This discharges
DF-S1.15-2's veto arm.**

**The bundle carries the bound extensions.** `AssembleInputs.extensions`
projects the sealed definition's `assembly.extensions.refs[]` through
`hh_registry::extension::trust_snapshot` (sorted, re-derivable
`snapshot_id`, refuses `Unresolved`/`UnknownVersion`/`KindMismatch`);
captured payload bytes deposit as members whose recomputed digest must
equal the `content` pin (`MemberMismatch` otherwise — the deposit *is*
the verification); absent bytes land `unpinned{not_captured}` with the
pin as the claim, and `section_member_refs` walks the pins *except*
declared-uncaptured claims (CC3; ADR-0289 D5). `audit_view.extensions`
answers AC-H5-10 per effect: `{context_extensions[], producer_extensions[]}`
folded from durable rows only — `context.assembled` taint tags,
`security.extension.*` declarations, `lifecycle.capability.registered`
producer refs (ADR-0289 D4).

**The audit export lowerings name their losses.** `hh-ledger::export`
lowers `audit_view` to `external_audit_record` / `telemetry` with a
`ExportLossReport` naming every dropped envelope field and view member;
`lift_external` yields `unverified` rows linked by `alias` (T-LCD-11 —
an external chain's integrity is never ours to assert).

**Fixes the battery surfaced.** `prove_inclusion` computed audit paths
over the full leaf array instead of the bounded prefix — AC-H6-6 caught
it; prefix proofs now verify (`tree.rs`). The `ledger_facts/1` codec
dropped the S3.8/S3.9 fact collections on round-trip — a CC3 silent-loss
gap; the codec now round-trips them (`leak_survives_the_facts_round_trip`
pins the discipline).
